newsitem.title: USA: Florida asks Sierra for merger information.
newsitem.headline: Florida asks Sierra for merger information.

text.p: Sierra Health Services Inc on Tuesday said the Florida Agency for Health Care Administration requested additional information on its proposed merger with Physician Corporation of America.
It said the agency, which administers the Florida Medicaid program, has indicated it would be unable to approve a Medicaid contract with Sierra based on the information already provided.

Sierra said the information requested by the state regulators related to planned management changes after completion of the merger and to services that Sierra subsidiaries would provide to Florida residents.

The agency also sought statements of Sierra's good standing from Medicaid programs in other states, significant shareholder information and more details about a 1991 misdemeanor conviction of Sierra's Chairman and Chief Executive Officer, Dr. Anthony Marlon, the company said.
It stressed that the notification from the Florida regulators was not a final decision and that the review process was still under way.

In a statement, Sierra said it would fully cooperate with the request and that it believed "upon providing the additional information, and through further discussions with (regulators), the approval will be forthcoming."
Company officials were not immediately available for further comment.
